title: Former employee was a Havana syndrome victim

tellings.quote:
>> One of them used to work for me. I know
him extremely well. Jesus.

plain: One of the people struck by Havana syndrome, the mysterious illness reported by US diplomats and intelligence officers, once worked for Eric Haseltine. Haseltine, a former NSA official, tells Michels: "One of them used to work for me. I know him extremely well," which gives the cases a personal witness rather than just a news story.
